name: arabic-carousel
description: Arabic design studio for social media: single posts, carousels and 9:16 reels in RTL Arabic. The assistant plans, writes and draws; the studio lays out independent editable elements, reflows content without unreadable text, checks every word, and delivers an offline editor (PNG, ZIP, PDF, video) or a real Canva design built and edited element by element, with a per-session capability registry, letter-by-letter Arabic read-back checks and reel scene plans. In ChatGPT and Codex this package provides the skills and a Node CLI for the Canva tools; it does not connect an MCP server. It reuses the creator's design library, assets and saved taste before generating anything new. From a topic alone it can decide audience, angle, titles and storyboard, design an educational white-and-mint carousel, and write one generation prompt per slide.

interface.longDescription: Describe an idea or paste your text and get a ready Arabic post, carousel or reel. The skill plans the visual idea, writes the copy, draws or reuses illustrations from your library, and lays out every page as separate editable elements that stay readable on a phone. You receive one offline HTML editor to edit by chat («كبّر العنوان قليلًا», «غيّر الرسم الرابع فقط»), undo, and export PNG, a ZIP in posting order, a LinkedIn PDF or a 9:16 reel. It remembers your identities and taste per account, never treating one edit as a rule. Arabic letters stay joined and mixed Arabic, English and numbers keep their order in every export. Canva tools: this package ships skills and a Node command-line tool (no MCP server); they plan and check work done through your Canva connector, and run only where the code environment has Node 18+.
